description: U8_Ash vitality: concussion hits, wounds, the death clock, and how any of it comes back. These are this game's rules, not part of the vendored Ash V1 package — that package produces concussion hits as a damage quantity and says only that they land on 'actor injury or vitality state'. This file is that state. Changing a value here changes the game without touching engine code.

hit_dice.description: Concussion hits are rolled, one die per level, and each die carries the constitution bonus with it. A die that would give less than minimum_per_die gives minimum_per_die: taking a level never makes a character frailer.

concussion_recovery.description: A day gives back one hit die. A full day of rest — a day plus a long rest, somewhere safe, with food and water — gives another, and medical attention another. What can actually be spent in a day is capped by level and by the dice the character has.

wounds.description: The layer under concussion hits: level plus the character's best ability bonus, whichever ability that is. Wounds are only lost once concussion hits have run out, and each one costs the use of a stat until they are healed.

wound_recovery.description: Wounds come back slowly and one at a time. A potion or a healing spell restores one wound and spends the rest of itself on concussion hits.

death_clock.description: At no wounds, a constitution save every round until it resolves one way or the other. Surviving is not free: the body keeps two stats' worth of damage until it is healed.

infection.description: Every day spent with wounds missing risks a complication: a constitution save against the standard of care, and a failure costs concussion hits.

care_levels.description: A full day of rest with medical treatment.
Rest, or treatment, but not both.
